note: Machine-readable record of the on-chain MeridianVault deployments that verify:contracts checks against. Meridian's vault is immutable (no update_current_contract_wasm), so the bytecode at a recorded address never changes. Editing a vault address here declares a redeployment and forces a source-build-and-chain verification in CI; leaving an address unchanged lets the check pass without a rebuild. The toolchain block pins the stellar-cli version used on that build path so a rebuild reproduces the recorded bytecode.
